architecture_findings.title: Mixed occupancy of global state
architecture_findings.detail: venus_data stores both the thing-in-itself (Q/P/PDOT/QDOT/Q_old) and about 40 representation blocks (print flags, roster/geometry QZA/QZB, GLO parameters, thermostat parameters, statistics arrays) in one module, with no comments distinguishing the two kinds; it also contains auro=2.94998 (the Au lattice constant) and a dozen-plus dead blocks with no writers / no consumers (MORSEB/STRETB/CUBEB/COORS/GAUSS2/GDD/HIST_ATOM_NAD/U0-U1-V01/RKUTTA)

architecture_findings.title: Dual random-stream coexistence
architecture_findings.detail: The reproducible main stream RAND0/RAND1/RANDST (Knuth, ISEED3) and the compiler-intrinsic RANDOM_NUMBER stream (gasdev/GAMA/grandom) are mixed within the same assembly/evolution paths; ISEED cannot control the latter, breaking trajectory-level reproducibility; moreover the core instrument gasdev physically lives in src_TEST/interface_TEST.f90 (a PES interface file), so the src_VENUS core depends in reverse on src_TEST for an instrument (layer inversion, held up only by Makefile order sensitivity)

architecture_findings.title: Interface A conformance
architecture_findings.detail: Conforms: no compile-time PES variants (runtime TEST_PES, single build multi-potential); unit conversion centralized at the interface_TEST boundary (23.0605 and C1); five members registered via a one-line case each. Violations: the GLO spring + random forces and ghost Langevin embedded in VERLET/ENERGY (stochastic laws not routed through interface A members per 3.2, atom indices hardcoded); test_potentials members writing back the representation/roster (BOXLX/BOXLY/SKEW/NATOMB/QZB)

architecture_findings.title: Phase-restriction check
architecture_findings.detail: No operation-class calls during evolution (phase restriction satisfied): inside the evolution loop only DVDQ (evolution), TEST/GWRITE/FINAL/GFINAL/ENERGY/record_all (measurement), and the integrators. Assembly-time SELECT/md_equilibrate calling evolution services is member-internal structure, explicitly allowed by 2.3 boundary 4. The only overreach is RADOUT duplicating control-kernel orchestration inside the propagator (calling FINAL/GFINAL and maintaining the NAST state machine) — an orchestration overreach, not a phase violation

architecture_findings.title: Compile-time coupling
architecture_findings.detail: The Makefile compiles in a single ordered command (order-sensitive; matches module dependencies but fragile); GLO.f not listed in SRC (an uncompiled near-duplicate lingering in the source tree); three MKL libraries linked but no MKL/LAPACK call anywhere in the sources (a dead build dependency); the two scripts tools float outside the build system

architecture_findings.title: Incomplete control kernel
architecture_findings.detail: VENUS.f90 embeds system branches (NSURF/GLO layout, FIXROTDATM, the THTA special case), observable selection and accumulation (BOUNCE/z_pos_min/AE* arrays), the outcome-handling blocks duplicated entire in two copies, and three blocks of dead code (the NCHKP branch / the RKUTTA coefficients / the idplt histogram block)

architecture_findings.title: Incomplete measurement layer
architecture_findings.detail: GWRITE (atom1=C, mass-threshold element names, nearest-Au, the 6.0 Å PBC box), TEST (a live C/Au height-criterion branch + two commented system-criterion blocks), record_all/HIST (the Au(111) hexagonal lattice), GFINAL.f:80 (EREL hardcoded to atom 3's 1D-model value overriding the generalized value), FINAL/POTENZ (fort.777/666 writing U0/U1/V01, which have no writers) — observable selection is nowhere demoted to configuration

architecture_findings.title: Redundancy total
architecture_findings.detail: About 26 dead entries / dead files: GLO.f (whole file), harmonic_sampling (no calls), VFDATE, POTEN, EBOND/ENMODE (MPLOT dead), WEBOND/WLBOND/WENMOD, MICROCI/VOLPSCONE, LMODE/LMEXCT (F20), GLOEQU/DISTRIBUTE, THERMBATH, PBC, FRICFORCE+DIAG2, LINEQ/LUDCMP/LUBKSB, FEHLER, ROTATEX_b/ROTATEZ_b, grandom/ran1/gasdev_0, the RKUTTA coefficients, the NCHKP branch, the NCVIB dead keyword, the MKL linking, the venus_data dead blocks

calibration_check.result: Not cleaned. The current form has evolved into atom1=C (GWRITE.f90:59-60 Q(C)=), plus the new W(i)<50 → C else Au mass-threshold element labeling (110-114) and the Au_nearest diagnostics (95) — consistent with the calibration-point conclusion (still a violation)

calibration_check.point: The RK4 dead entry and broken ADAMS should be redundancy candidates
calibration_check.result: Confirmed. RK4 is accepted by param_mapping as INTEGRATOR=1,LLL=0, but venus_input.f90:363-365 rejects LLL=0 — a dead entry that stops on read-in; the RKUTTA coefficients at VENUS.f90:86-94 have no consumers. ADAMS (INTEGRATOR=0) is explicitly loud-stopped at venus_input.f90:339-343 — upgraded from broken to explicitly rejected; the elimination conclusion stands

calibration_check.point: The TEST.f termination criteria should be closed predicate-grammar members
calibration_check.result: Confirmed. TEST.f:88-94 contains a live C/Au(111) system branch (atom1 height + the NC>50 magic number + P(3)>0), with commented system-criterion blocks at 54-78/149-192 (F+H2O, CH4/Ni); the generic COM-distance criterion at 106-146 is the correct prototype of a grammar member

calibration_check.point: No compile-time PES variants (TEST_PES runtime selection) should be recorded as conforming to interface A
calibration_check.result: Confirmed. The interface_TEST.f90 header comment explicitly declares single-build multi-potential; the five members are registered at runtime via the TEST_PES keyword, with no compile-time variants
